name: Boundary Overload Fire Blitz
formation: Boundary Overload Tilt vs 11P Gun Trips Right

summary.motive: Exploit half-slide offensive protections toward passing strength by launching an unblockable boundary corner overload while rotating safety coverage into the vacated perimeter void.
summary.keyDefender: LCB (Boundary Corner Blitzer) & LOLB (Pinning Defensive End)
summary.whyItWorks: The boundary tackle cannot pass off the inside DE spike and pick up the blitzing corner, creating a pure free rusher to the quarterback’s blind side.
summary.failureMode: A quick slip screen to the running back into the boundary flat if the offensive line catches the blitz and releases early.

beats.title: Boundary Press & Slide Bait
beats.text: Todd Bowles aligns LCB in hard press on isolated receiver X, enticing the offense to slide protection right toward the Trips side and leave the boundary tackle in 1-on-1 isolation.

beats.title: The Overload Launch
beats.text: At the snap, LOLB crashes inside into the B-gap, pulling the LT inside. LCB sprints off the perimeter with a free, unblocked runway straight to the QB’s blindside.

beats.title: Safety Replaces the Void
beats.text: Free Safety (FS) screams downhill from two-high depth into the boundary flat, taking away the quarterback’s immediate hot answer to X.

beats.title: Violent Blindside Turnover
beats.text: LCB drills the quarterback from behind at full speed, knocking the ball loose for a drive-ending strip-sack.

relations.tell: Boundary corner creeps close to line with inside tilt while safety aligns at 12 yards on boundary hash preparing to rotate down
